sloka: श्रुत्वा तत् जामदग्न्यस्य वाक्यम् दाशरथिः तदा ।गौरवात् यंत्रित कथः पितू रामम् अथ अब्रवीत् ॥१-७६-१॥
transliteration: śrutvā tat jāmadagnyasya vākyam dāśarathiḥ tadā ।gauravāt yaṁtrita kathaḥ pitū rāmam atha abravīt ॥1-76-1॥

translations.english: Hearing the words of the son of Jamadagni (Parasurama), Rama, the son of Dasaratha, avoiding further conversation out of respect for his father intercepted Parasurama saying:
